messages:
maria (support): FYI - LowScale (enterprise private) reported ~1.2k objects with expires_at=2025-12-01 still showing up in search after TTL. Legal is asking for a preservation timeline; customer says they didn't request any hold. Can infra/kms check for holds or KMS errors during the deletion window?

 tim (oncall): Can you share one example object metadata and the exact API call they used to confirm visibility + tenant id?

 maria (support): tenant=lowscale-prod. Example metadata:
```
object_id: obj_9a8b7c
retention_mode: default
expires_at: 2025-12-01T00:00:00Z
deleted: false
```
They called GET /v1/objects?tenant=lowscale-prod&visible=true and saw those still returned. Tried DELETE -> 202 accepted but no tombstone was created.

 jordan (infra): Pulling scheduler logs now. Quick scan shows delete-scheduler run on 2025-12-02 with 173 jobs; 8 were marked skipped due to KMS decryption failures. Query run: GET /internal/delete-jobs?tenant=lowscale-prod&since=2025-12-01 returned: jobs=173, skipped=8, reason=kms_decrypt_error, last_attempt=2025-12-02T03:12:11Z.

 kms-bot: KMS/HSM proxy logs for key k_lowscale_01 around window:
```
2025-12-02T03:09:54Z HSM-proxy -> 503 transient
2025-12-02T03:10:07Z HSM-proxy -> 403 throttled
2025-12-02T03:15:02Z HSM-proxy -> 200 OK
```
No rotation events shown in that interval.

 jordan (infra): Root cause looks like transient auth/throttle from customer HSM cluster which prevented unwrap/decrypt for tombstone creation. If we can't unwrap key material we skip creating a tombstone.

 priya (legal): We need an audit packet for Legal and for the customer: exact object IDs that remained visible, scheduler entries showing skip, KMS log snippets, and confirmation whether any preserve/pause flags were set at object/container/org level. If no preserve flags, include statement that we did not block deletion intentionally.

 maria (support): Confirmed preserve_flag=false for the sample objects. Customer says they never requested a hold (I've asked for written confirmation).

 tim (oncall): Action plan: 1) infra to backfill skipped deletions for lowscale-prod immediately 2) coordinate a controlled manual purge window only after Legal approves 3) support to obtain written customer confirmation 4) Legal to draft interim customer statement.

 jordan (infra): Started a backfill job targeting the 8 skipped deletion jobs. Tail of logs:
```
2025-12-02T03:30:10Z backfill:start tenant=lowscale-prod skipped=8
2025-12-02T03:31:45Z job=obj_9a8b7c tombstone-created
2025-12-02T03:34:02Z backfill:complete processed=8
```
Backfill created tombstones for all previously skipped objects. I also implemented a short-term scheduler change to retry transient KMS 403/503/429 up to 5 times with exponential backoff; PR #458 opened for a proper retry/backoff implementation.

 priya (legal): Good. Please assemble the artifact bundle for Legal: CSV of object_ids, scheduler logs (skip -> backfill -> tombstone), KMS/HSM snippets showing throttle window, and support confirmation that preserve flags were not set. We'll prepare a letter for the customer.

 maria (support): Customer confirmed via Slack DM: "We did not ask for any preservation hold. Please go ahead." I've copied that into the case notes.

 jordan (infra): Uploaded CSV and logs to secure case file SFC-2025-0923. PR #458 and a monitoring alert added to watch for similar KMS-throttle patterns.

 tim (oncall): Next steps: infra to monitor for other tenants affected, support/legal to send remediation timeline to customer including purge completion timestamp, ops to create a postmortem ticket.

 maria (support): Sent customer-facing remediation note with timeline; customer acknowledged and accepted. Closing immediate escalation. :white_check_mark: 

 jordan (infra): Filed postmortem ticket TICKET-1249 and assigned to infra + kms teams. Severity S2. Will include mitigations (scheduler retries, alerting, and HSM-throttle runbooks).

 maria (support): Thanks all — please paste links to PR and postmortem when available. :eyes:
